name: A signed-out fallback deep link (#/jfbm-demo-b?tab=deep) goes to the login page and back, with no "Page not found" frame. Needs EnablePageDemo on (pages-fallback.json turns it on).

steps.name: open the deep link signed out
redirected to the login page with url=
the url parameter holds the deep link
sign in on that login page
back on Demo page B (fallback host) with the extra parameter
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll("#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page=\"demo-b\"][data-jfbm-mounted]")].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); const t = (document.querySelector('.skinHeader .pageTitle') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim(); const title = r && r.querySelector('.jfbm-demo-title'); const user = r && r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-demo="user"]'); if (!r || !title || title.textContent !== "Demo page B" || [...document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage > :not([data-jfbm-page]) h1')].some(h => h.getClientRects().length > 0) || t !== "Demo page B" || !user || user.textContent === '…') return false; if (JSON.parse(r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-demo="params"]').textContent).tab !== 'deep') return false; return { hash: location.hash, render: Number(r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-render')), reason: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-reason'), host: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-host'), params: JSON.parse(r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-demo="params"]').textContent), user: user.textContent, admin: r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-demo="admin"]').textContent, headerTitle: t, documentTitle: document.title, historyLength: history.length }; })()

steps.name: every navigation above: 0 "Page not found" frames on our routes
steps.message: a probe counted "Page not found" frames on a demo route
